???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What check makes sure `values[index]` stays inside the array, and when does it happen?"

        A bounds check. It happens during compilation when the index is already known, and at run time otherwise.

        Introduced in [5. Expressions](08-expressions.md). Specification: [7. Arrays and shapes](../specification/arrays.md#76-indexing).

    ??? question "How do you convert `count` to an `f32` in Vortex, and what is this called?"

        With a cast written like a call, `f32(count)`. A value that does not fit the new type is reported as an error rather than silently changed.

        Introduced in [5. Expressions](08-expressions.md). Specification: [4. Types and values](../specification/types-and-values.md#412-casts-and-conversions).

    ??? question "What do we call a piece of code that produces a value, such as `2 + 3` or `square(4.0)`?"

        An expression. A statement, by contrast, does something and produces no value.

        Introduced in [5. Expressions](08-expressions.md). Specification: [5. Expressions](../specification/expressions.md#51-expression-forms).
